name: Hierarchical Rectangle Selection
summary: Rectangle (marquee) selection on screen that also takes the gravitational hierarchy into account, so supported objects are grouped with their supports.
howItWorks: The user drags a rectangle on the screen as in conventional rectangle selection, and the selection is then refined using the scene's contact graph so that objects resting on selected objects come along, avoiding the need to check the selection from several viewpoints.
